from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
baseline=root.parent/'remaining-crop-ablation-v1'
read=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
write=lambda n,a:(root/n).write_text(json.dumps(a,indent=2)+'\n')
assert read(baseline/'state.json')['status']=='complete'
assert not(root/'state.json').exists()
inputs=read(baseline/'inputs.json');pins=read(baseline/'source.json')
for p in [root/'run.py',root/'diagnostics.json']:pins[str(p)]=sha(p)
write('source.json',pins)
def verify():
    for p,h in pins.items():assert sha(p)==h,p
started=time.monotonic();results=[]
for row in inputs['rows']:
    verify();name=row['id']+'-'+row['variant'];output=root/name
    cmd=['node','scripts/inverse/hard-photo-benchmark.mjs','--ids='+row['id'],'--crop=fixed','--crop-overrides='+row['override'],'--diagnostics='+str(root/'diagnostics.json'),'--target=mask','--seconds=10','--presets=automatic','--output='+str(output)]
    with(root/(name+'.log')).open('w')as log:
        p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        write('state.json',dict(status='running',id=row['id'],variant=row['variant'],controllerPid=os.getpid(),pid=p.pid,completed=len(results),total=4));code=p.wait()
    verify()
    if code:
        write('state.json',dict(status='failed',id=row['id'],variant=row['variant'],exitCode=code));raise SystemExit(code)
    item=read(output/'results.json')['results'][0];run=item['runs'][0]
    previous=read(baseline/name/'results.json')['results'][0];before=previous['runs'][0]
    assert item['effectiveQuad']==previous['effectiveQuad']
    assert run['settings']=={**before['settings'],'mode':'red-white-mixture'}
    assert item['input']==previous['input']
    assert run['observation']==before['observation']
    assert run['fittingSoftPixels']==0,'Only the classifier changes; fitting still receives a binary mask.'
    results.append(dict(id=row['id'],variant=row['variant'],status=item['status'],passed=run['passed'],seconds=run.get('solveAndValidationSeconds'),maskSha256=run['fittingMaskSha256'],independentError=run.get('independentImageComparison'),features=run.get('independentFeatures'),selectedCounts=run.get('report',{}).get('solver',{}).get('selectedCounts'),materialReview=run.get('materialReview'),report=str(output/'results.json'),baselineReport=str(baseline/name/'results.json')))
    write('results.json',dict(status='running',results=results));print(name,item['status'],flush=True)
verify();write('results.json',dict(status='complete',results=results))
write('state.json',dict(status='complete',seconds=time.monotonic()-started,sourceFilesVerified=len(pins)))
